label: Cookie consent
message: We'd like to use analytics cookies (Google Analytics and PostHog) to understand how the site is used. They're set only if you accept, and you can change your mind at any time.
messageOn: Analytics (Google Analytics and PostHog, including session recordings) are on for this site in your region. Reject turns them off, and you can change your mind at any time.
messageGpc: Your browser sent a Global Privacy Control signal, so analytics (Google Analytics and PostHog) are off. Accept turns them on, and you can change your mind at any time.
